claimLink.title: Claim {{club}} on Wat2Do
claimLink.description: Your club's page is ready. Claiming it makes you its owner: your club and its events get a verified check, and you can post events and positions, give out free QR tickets and scan them at the door.
claimLink.invalidDescription: It may be mistyped, or someone on your team has already claimed the club. Ask them to add you from the club panel.
